dashboard.consoleError: Unable to load consoles. Use Refresh to try again.
dashboard.profileUnavailable: Profile information is not available yet.
dashboard.requestFailed: An application request failed. Please try again.
dashboard.presetDescription: Apply a bitrate limit to both Remote Play and Cloud Gaming. Resolution and actual quality depend on Xbox and your connection.
dashboard.handheldDescription: Compact navigation, larger controls and more space for games. Automatic mode follows the window size.
dashboard.secretDescription: Unlock this achievement to reveal its details.
dashboard.experimentalWarning: Experimental player supports bitrate and codec preferences, physical and virtual controller input, microphone negotiation and audio controls. Some Xbox services may not support all features.
dashboard.experimentalFailed: Experimental player could not connect. Return to settings and select the classic player.
dashboard.microphoneFailed: Microphone could not be enabled. Check permissions or use the classic player.
dashboard.rendererDescription: WebGPU is experimental. The standard renderer is used when GPU initialization fails.
dashboard.nativeMkbHint: Click the video to capture mouse and keyboard. Press Esc to release. Requires game support.
dashboard.inputNextStream: Changes apply to the next V3 streaming session.
dashboard.remappingDescription: Map each Xbox action to a physical browser gamepad button index. Changes apply to the next V3 session.
dashboard.profileDescription: Save up to 20 named input configurations. Saving an existing name replaces that profile.
dashboard.qualityHint_good: Latency and jitter are within the indicative targets.
dashboard.qualityHint_fair: Consider Ethernet or reducing the bitrate before the next session.
dashboard.qualityHint_poor: Check network congestion and consider a lower bitrate preset.
dashboard.qualityHint_insufficient: Waiting for enough video and latency samples.
dashboard.gameProfileDescription: Override global bitrate for this cloud game. Renderer and controller profile overrides apply only to V3.
dashboard.consoleProfileDescription: Override bitrate for this console. Renderer and controller profile overrides apply only to V3.
dashboard.consoleProfileLimit: You have reached the limit of 50 console profiles.
dashboard.backupDescription: Export portable preferences and controller, game and console profiles. Backups exclude sign-in credentials and WebUI network settings, but may contain console identifiers and names.
dashboard.backupConfirm: Apply {{count}} validated settings? Existing values for these preferences will be replaced.
dashboard.backupInvalid: Invalid or unsupported settings backup (maximum 1 MB).
dashboard.backupRestored: Settings restored. Restart the app for all changes to take effect.
dashboard.historyDescription: Optional local history for Classic and V3 streaming attempts. Keeps up to 100 records with duration, outcome and recent connection statistics. No console, game, account or network identifiers are stored.
dashboard.clearHistoryConfirm: Delete all locally saved streaming history?
dashboard.controllerTestDescription: Inspect physical controller input locally. Press a controller button if the device is not detected.
dashboard.calibrationInstructions: Release both sticks and keep the window focused for three seconds. This estimates a V3 deadzone from resting stick drift.
dashboard.calibrationFailed: Calibration interrupted or excessive movement detected. Release the sticks and try again.
dashboard.nonstandardController: This device does not expose the standard gamepad layout. Raw button and axis readings remain available.
dashboard.videoFilterDescription: Adjust the displayed V3 video without changing the encoded stream. Effects apply to standard video and WebGPU output.
dashboard.endStreamDescription: The remote streaming session will be stopped. Your game may continue running on the console.
dashboard.restartQualityWarning: This starts a new streaming session with a requested {{bitrate}} Mbps cap. Cloud Gaming may require joining the queue again and unsaved progress could be lost. Global settings will not change.
dashboard.networkGraphWindow: Recent 60 seconds of streaming measurements. Each graph uses its own scale.
dashboard.consoleController: Controller connected to Xbox (V3 Remote Play)
dashboard.consoleControllerDescription: Use the controller paired directly to your Xbox. Both Classic and V3 skip virtual controller registration and local input forwarding in this mode while continuing video acknowledgements. Enable before starting Remote Play. Cloud Gaming is unaffected.
dashboard.sharpeningHint: Optional local edge enhancement. Higher values can exaggerate compression artifacts and increase rendering load; set to 0% to disable.
dashboard.captureStandardVideoHint: Requires standard video rendering and a decoded frame. Screenshots and floating video exclude visual filters and overlays.
dashboard.screenshotFailed: Unable to capture a video frame.
dashboard.pipFailed: Picture-in-picture is unavailable for this stream.
dashboard.saveClipBeforeExit: Save or discard your recorded clip before ending the stream.
dashboard.resolutionHint: Advertise a 720p or 1080p client display when starting a new session. Xbox determines the actual encoded resolution; this preference is not a guarantee.
dashboard.recoveryPending: Attempting to restart the Remote Play session shortly. This may interrupt gameplay.
dashboard.failure_media: No inbound audio or video progress for 15 seconds, despite a connected transport.
dashboard.failure_transport: The WebRTC transport disconnected or failed.
dashboard.failure_heartbeat: The Xbox session stopped responding to keepalive requests.
dashboard.failure_stats: WebRTC statistics stopped updating for 15 seconds. The native media pipeline may be stalled.
dashboard.autoRecoveryPreference: Remember automatic recovery across V3 Remote Play sessions. Recovery is limited to two attempts and may interrupt gameplay.
dashboard.failure_server: Xbox requested that the streaming session disconnect.
dashboard.streamShortcutsHint: Choose F6–F10 or disable each action. Assigning an existing key clears its previous shortcut. Shortcuts are ignored while editing text, using native pointer lock or when mapped to gamepad emulation.
dashboard.captureLibraryDescription: Screenshots and clips saved explicitly to this device. Maximum 512 MiB or 200 items. Download important captures before clearing app data or uninstalling.
dashboard.captureLibraryFailed: Unable to access or save to the capture library. Check storage space or download the capture instead.
dashboard.captureLibraryEmpty: No saved captures in this view.
dashboard.replayFailed: Replay unavailable or no recent segment could be saved.
dashboard.replaySaved: Replay ready. Download or save to library.
dashboard.multiControllerDescription: Allow up to four controllers connected to this device, each with its own remote slot. Game and service support may vary. Disabled while using the controller paired directly to Xbox. Changes apply to the next stream.
dashboard.adaptiveRecoveryHint: When automatic Remote Play recovery is enabled, lower the bitrate for the next attempt only if recent fresh statistics show sustained poor connection quality. Does not restart healthy streams or change saved quality preferences.
dashboard.sessionQualityOverride: Temporary bitrate override for this session
dashboard.replayDurationHint: Choose 15, 30 or 60 seconds for the next stream. Replay remains opt-in and segments may be shorter.
dashboard.diagnosticsViewerHint: Open a Greenlight Classic or V3 diagnostic JSON report (up to 2 MiB). Reports are analysed locally and are not uploaded or saved.
dashboard.diagnosticsImportFailed: Unable to read this diagnostic report. Select a supported Greenlight JSON export.
dashboard.classicFailure_closed: The streaming input channel closed unexpectedly. Return to the dashboard and reconnect.
dashboard.classicFailure_keepalive: Three consecutive session keepalive requests failed. Return to the dashboard and reconnect.
dashboard.streamKeepAwakeHint: Keep this computer and display awake during connected Remote Play sessions in the desktop app. Does not simulate controller input or override Xbox/game inactivity limits. Disabled by default.
dashboard.graphGapHint: Gaps indicate missing or stale samples. The latest value is hidden when statistics are unavailable.
dashboard.failure_closed: The Classic streaming input channel closed unexpectedly.
dashboard.classicScreenshotFailed: Could not capture or save this video frame.
dashboard.classicPipFailed: Picture-in-picture is unavailable for this video.
dashboard.compareDiagnosticsHint: Open a second report as a baseline. Values are descriptive differences (current minus baseline), not a controlled performance benchmark.
dashboard.classicRetryFailed: The previous session could not be stopped. Retry or return to the dashboard.
dashboard.classicRetrying: Stopping the previous session before reconnecting…
